## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues and explain
public API or feature changes, if any.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. State checks you could not run and why.
For behavior changes, describe the regression test. For documentation changes,
check examples and links as appropriate.

## Fixtures and compatibility

Describe any font, corpus, snapshot, browser baseline, dependency, or compatibility
changes and how you reviewed them. Write "None" if this does not apply.
